abstract: Gartner predicts that by 2026, 20% of organizations will leverage AI to flatten organizational structures, resulting in the elimination of more than half of middle management positions. This forecast highlights AI's potential to reshape corporate hierarchies and workforce composition in the coming years.
keyFindings: 20% of organizations will use AI to flatten organizational structure by 2026
AI adoption will lead to elimination of more than half of middle management positions in affected organizations
methodology: Not specified. This appears to be a Gartner predictive forecast based on their research and analysis, but specific data sources, sample size, or analytical methodology are not provided in the excerpt.
qualifiers: These are predictions for a future time period (through 2026) rather than empirical findings from past data. The prediction applies only to a subset of organizations (20%), indicating variable adoption rates. Scope is general workforce, not EdTech-specific.
